# DiAlgo

Canonical site: https://dialgo.net/
Last updated: 2026-10-10

DiAlgo is a mobile app (iPhone and Android) that connects an older adult or person who needs support with their family. The older person sees one screen with a few large buttons ("Good morning", "I'm fine", "Call me", "I need help") and taps one; the message reaches the whole family instantly. The family also manages the person's medication reminders and medical appointments from their own phones.

Languages of this site: Español (default, `/`), English (`/en/`), and the main Catalan pages (`/ca/`). The app itself is available in English, Spanish and Catalan.

## App availability and price

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/es/app/dialgo/id6738914468
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arnohealth.dialgo
- 30-day free trial with no card. Then EUR 9.99 per month in Spain (price may vary by country and store). Only the family administrator pays; there is no limit on family members.

## What DiAlgo is not

- It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
- It is not telecare or an emergency service: the "I need help" button alerts the family, not the emergency services.
- No clinical study has measured the effect of DiAlgo itself. The research cited on the site supports design decisions, not outcome claims.
